## The Cell Theory

According to the classical Cell Theory:

- All living organisms are made up of one or more cells.
- The cell is the basic unit of structure and function in living beings.
- All cells arise from pre-existing cells.

<!-- STEP -->
## Why this matters

These three statements join all of biology, from bacteria to humans, into one idea. They also explain how life continues: through cell division, each new cell comes from an older one.

A theory in science is not a guess. It is an explanation backed by a very large body of evidence.
